Generating.title: AI Resume Builder
Generating.heading: Crafting Your Resume
Generating.description: Our AI is analyzing your conversation and building a professional resume.
Generating.tip1: Quantified achievements (e.g., "increased revenue by 30%") make your resume 40% more effective.
Generating.tip2: The best resumes focus on decisions you made and their impact, not just responsibilities.
Generating.tip3: Hiring managers spend an average of 7 seconds scanning a resume initially.
Generating.tip4: Using the PAR method (Problem → Action → Result) helps frame your achievements clearly.
Generating.tip5: Tailoring your resume to each role can double your interview callback rate.
